notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience, version 1.2 is now online

New food system: Food provides nutrition, character attributes are obtained based on nutrition, and buffs are obtained when multiple foods are eaten at the same time. Food has freshness. Food that has been left for too long will rot, and eating rotten food will cause diarrhea.

New component lunch box: Food can be put into the lunch box, and the food in the lunch box will be automatically eaten.

Night: The brightness at night has been improved, and the night is no longer pitch black; now aggressive fluorescent slimes will appear at night.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/c05e058bb78fa72f5b02c21a63fc00b1af408092.png


Animals: Added cows and sheep.
Animal capture and taming: Use a cannon to fire rope net bullets to capture animals, and raise animals to obtain their by-products at regular intervals.
New crops: corn, white radish, carrots Potato; tomato model update{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/cb6640f4088399875481743969f15844473549fc.jpg


Composter: Putting rotten food in can produce fertilizer, fertilizing crops will double the yield
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/713315018b6a62f1b1c88d311eaccccb02426261.jpg


Iron pot: Can combine multiple foods into a more nutritious soup
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/5b66531753ead987c2cb88ab73c778a392a0986e.jpg

Giant weapons：Breaking to get lead fragments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/7d3047576f78c8d354cc06e8c1ae47a8f1969ca9.jpg

WreckingBall: A powerful demolition tool
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/0459ddb6bba2736ad14bcfee72c692a0746e06be.gif


New desert cave
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/bca39418530385f2ed02dbbb4acfb14307d91d38.jpg

Excavator mission update: Use an excavator to collect rare earth ores in desert caves
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/a0a4dab1efb3de29e98818d128cd8915f23fb1eb.gif

Desert boss: Sandworm
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/40a7a4ce0051e758e77906384676d8a3efa6280e.jpg


Summon boss: You need to activate the diamond tower on the giant hand and build a road to send the energy ball into the hole in the boss's field
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/877a43a553715fb6d9318bcc0c1492cdac04f285.jpg


Paraglider: Allows you to glide in the sky
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/ae1358002dea8f2192a907c0483a96276f74840a.jpg


Vat: Can extend the corruption time of food, needs to be built underground{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/a6ed789ae2ccbb9703a5890c410821b432de2cf6.jpg


Refrigerator: Can further extend the corruption time of food, requires batteries{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/d59ac253e771c6a88fd1c43ab91214a8b9bb8fc2.jpg


Wooden track: Allows you to quickly travel between two places{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/b2483e46493d6995d52e2ae4e055b6d9a5a72257.jpg


Desert terrain flattened
Old version saves and new files are not supported, it is recommended to restart a new file
A large number of bug fixes
Online and sound effect issues will be left to 1.3

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/2c067e252af3462ce40d4c39c60250b33261e7da.gif

Fluid water:
- Now the water can flow and spread, even flooding the whole world
 
New buildings:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/4e47a960bbf7ca4596b50e925d3c2bfcc715b7e9.png

-Bonfire:  Cooking food can increase the satiety of food

-Barbecue grill:  A larger barbecue grill that can cook 3 foods at the same time

- Simple water purifier:  boiling the sewage into clean water

-Automatic water purifier:  can automatically filter sewage without fuel

-Electric water purifier: can automatically pump water after connecting the water pipe, without manual addition, but it needs to consume batteries

-Grinding wheel:  can repair items

- Battery charger:  able to charge the battery

-Automatic sprinkler:  After connecting to the water source, it can automatically water the surrounding crops, requiring battery consumption

-Water pipe:  The pipe connecting to the water source. Please insert one end into the water when using it

-Water pipe diverter:  Can divert water to multiple water pipes

- Ore washing machine: can refine rare metals in ores

- Teleportation Gates:  Let you teleport between different teleportation gates

- Runestone Table: allows you to strengthen runes

-Leather drying rack:  can process animal fur into leather

- Small furnace:  Capable of processing ore

-Large melting furnace: can process more ores and has a 3 times faster smelting speed

-Carbonization furnace: can convert wood into coal

- Rope rack:  Capable of placing the rope to the ground

-Zipline:  The rope allows you to quickly shuttle through the air

- Stronghold:  A stronghold allows you to recruit NPCs

- Battery:  can provide energy for the equipment

 
Vehicle:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44796300/93c9986eb60235d956f349bd890864ec4e8dd35e.png

- Treasure Hunt Removed: The last updated treasure hunt task has been removed, and we will add it back at the right time
 
- Basic guide: added task guidance and help
 
-Continuous construction: Now, by holding down the construction button and dragging, you can continuously construct a whole wall of blocks
 
-Incompatible with the archive: This update has made a lot of changes, and the old game data conflicts with the new version. Please recreate the world and characters
 
-Online exception: There are many exceptions in the online part of Version 1.1, which will be fixed in Version 1.2
